description: An inference service: vendor + endpoint + key. Returned by GET /service and embedded in the service list. The id is the stable slug used in config file names and logs.

metadata.id: stable slug, conventionally vendor-endpoint lowercased and hyphenated (opencode-go, opencode-zen, mistral-ai). Mono providers may expose an alias (anthropic for anthropic-anthropic) at the UI/CLI layer; the wire id never changes.
metadata.enabled: derived at runtime: the service is enabled iff its api_key_env_var resolves to a non-empty value in the proxy environment AND the operator has not set enabled=false in the service config. Both conditions are AND-ed.
metadata.api_key_env_var: the NAME of the environment variable, never its value.
metadata.kind: reserved for future service types (e.g. mcp); every compliant proxy MUST expose at least one kind=inference service.
metadata.aliases: alternative names other tools may use for this service; purely advisory.
metadata.models: the embedded model list is defined by the composite service-list schema (see service-list.jtd.json), not here: RFC 8927 refs are same-document only.
